traits.name: Saint's Blood
traits.expression: Holy light radiates from your touch.
traits.story_hook: Enemies of the faith hunt you; you cannot lie well.
traits.hidden_cost: Hunted by those who oppose the faith

traits.name: Dragon's Favor
traits.description: Dragons won't attack; can call them for aid
traits.expression: Dragons regard you with respect and interest.
traits.story_hook: Dragons collect their debts; this favor costs.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: +15% to all rolls; fate may balance it later
traits.story_hook: Good luck now may mean bad luck later; fate balances.

traits.name: Immortal Youth
traits.description: +50 years of life; you outlive everyone you love
traits.expression: You do not age as others; youth clings to you.
traits.story_hook: You watch everyone you love grow old and die.

traits.name: Magical Savant
traits.description: Learn spells 50% faster; risk of addiction and burnout
traits.story_hook: Magic is addictive; you may burn out and lose it all.
traits.hidden_cost: Risk of magical burnout and addiction
